summary.intent: Complete gap-closure phases 42 (API unpin integrity), 43 (FUSE write durability), and 44 (IPNS conflict handling) from a UAT audit (PR #484) using the GSD workflow system's discuss → plan → execute pipeline across all three phases.
summary.outcome: Phases 42 and 43 fully completed with all plans executed, merged, reviewed, verified, and closed out. Phase 44 reached mid-wave-2 execution (3/5 plans done: ConflictError+mergeChildren, merge-and-republish retry loop, file CAS publish); wave 3 dispatched but transcript ends before merge.

repo: Kubo runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), meaning every pinned CID is broadcast as a DHT provider record — blobs are encrypted but CIDs are public by design, making cross-user unpin a real low-effort attack surface.
The IPFS unpin controller never read req.user before phase 42 — any JWT holder could POST any harvested CID directly to Kubo pin/rm, a cross-tenant data-destruction vulnerability.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids (shared-write.ts:450) without unpinning, so there was no legitimate cross-user unpin path even for write-share recipients.
BYO IPFS provider 'not pinned' errors must be swallowed server-side; guardedUnpin handles this correctly since the advisory row simply doesn't exist.

`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` is broken — pnpm inserts its own `--` so jest treats the flag as a positional regex; use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'` instead.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git Bash calls; signing failures that print 'agent returned an error' require restarting the 1Password desktop app.
The gsd commit helper returns `"committed": false` as a false negative while the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log` before retrying.
eslint already ignores `.planning/` and `.claude/` directories, but no `.prettierignore` existed — prettier was silently mangling planning markdown and JS files until one was created.

`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp` cannot complete on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in `windows-future` and `winfsp-sys` registry crates unrelated to this work; use `cargo check` for project-code validation instead.
IPNS records are published to the public IPFS network (how TEE republishing and recovery tool work), so any observer of an IPNS name can resolve the current metadata CID without credentials.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID without ownership check; now routed through guardedUnpin with D-13 race-window comment.
PendingUnpin must be added to forFeature here, and IPFS_PROVIDER must be provided via a local useFactory — importing IpfsModule creates a circular dependency.

Receives ipnsRecord and calls batchPublishIpnsRecords — must be updated in phase 44-04 to consume the new updateFileMetadata return shape {ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids} and drop the downstream batch-publish call.
Same batchPublishIpnsRecords pattern as useFileOperations — must be updated in phase 44-04 alongside it.
CR-04: prepare_result's Err arm was missing reply.error(libc::EIO); the trailing reply.ok() was acking the OS after a journal fsync failure, creating silent data loss.

Had spawn_journal.remove(&journal_entry_id) in the background upload thread (CR-08 misalignment) — removal must be gated on per-file IPNS publish success, not on upload success, to avoid orphaned journal entries.

Full rewrite in phase 43-01: now contains JournalOp, JournalEntryStatus, JournalEntry, and WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay — the old call sites in sync.rs were removed.
Kubo v0.40 configured with server profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp) — server profile only disables local-network discovery, keeps full public DHT participation.

workflow: The GSD cleanup-wave helper must run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree — it resolves repoRoot from cwd, and running from a worktree path produces false base_mismatch errors.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged worktree entries report branch_mismatch on a second run. Reduce the manifest to only remaining (not yet merged) entries before retrying.
Worktree cruft (node_modules/, .husky/_) must be removed before cleanup-wave runs — untracked dirs in a worktree block the merge step entirely.
When a merge concludes with MERGE_HEAD still present (all conflicts auto-resolved but the commit step failed), `git commit --no-edit` concludes it cleanly.

openapi.json formatting-only drift accumulates in the main tree as a side-effect of `nest build`; run `git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json` before merging worktrees to avoid phantom diffs.

When the planner socket-errors mid-run after writing some plan files, verify what's complete on disk before spawning a continuation planner — the first planner may have written valid files up to the point of failure.
Decision coverage gates use mechanical grep for literal `D-07:` citation format — plans must include truth lines in must_haves sections, not just prose references.
GSD auto-advances discuss→plan→execute when project config `auto_advance: true`; the manager loop chains them without additional user prompts once the user selects Continue.
Multi-glob rm commands (`rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules`) abort entirely if any glob has no match — use explicit single paths for reliability.
The per-CID advisory lock pattern (`pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid))`) closes the concurrent-unpin refcount race entirely, making a reconciliation job detect-only rather than load-bearing.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures fired twice mid-workflow ('agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object'), requiring the user to restart the 1Password desktop app before commits could proceed.
Session quota limit hit three times during execution, interrupting the wave-5 executor dispatch for phase 43 and requiring re-dispatch of plans 43-06 and 43-07 from scratch.
gsd commit helper returned 'committed: false' while the commit had actually landed on multiple occasions, wasting time on blind retries and manual git log verification.
Planner socket error after writing 3/8 plans for phase 42 due to a network interruption, requiring detection of partial output on disk and spawning a continuation planner for the remaining plans.
cleanup-wave CWD sensitivity caused false base_mismatch failures on first wave-2 merge attempt because the helper was invoked from inside an agent worktree path.
cleanup-wave non-idempotency caused the wave-2 retry to fail on already-merged entries, requiring hand-construction of reduced manifest files.
openapi.json formatting drift from a nest build side-effect in the main tree had to be manually detected and reverted before each wave's worktree merge.
prettier had no .prettierignore, causing it to mangle planning markdown and a regex pipe in VALIDATION.md into a table column that broke the testPathPattern command.
Two accidental user inputs ('touring wyatt web bossy') interrupted execution mid-wave — one while a git merge was staged and awaiting commit, requiring investigation of repo state before resuming.
pnpm's `--` flag forwarding broke targeted jest test runs throughout all three phases, requiring workaround via `pnpm exec jest` for every gate.
open_items: Phase 44 plan 44-04 (sweep all TS callers of updateFolderMetadataAndPublish and updateFileMetadata to consume new return shapes) and any remaining plans still pending execution.

Phase 43 has 4 UAT items in 43-UAT.md requiring human runtime testing: macOS FUSE crash-recovery replay, Windows WinFsp crash-recovery replay, tray WriteParked notification on both platforms, and cross-platform mount replay correctness.
Security gate: SECURITY.md is missing for phase 42 — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` was flagged in the close-out but not run.
Pending uploads UI (tray status count only implemented in phase 43; full pending-uploads panel deferred to a future phase per user's explicit instruction).
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred from phase 42 — currently the server handles BYO advisory rows correctly but the client provider.unpin is not integrated into delete flows.
Writable-share prunedCids orphan leak (shared-write.ts:450 drops prunedCids without unpinning) deferred — no cross-user unpin exists today so this is a quota-accounting leak, not a data-loss issue.
Rust FUSE conflict-handling parity for phase 44 deferred — TypeScript SDK gets the mergeChildren three-way merge and ConflictError; Rust crate parity is a separate future task.
ROADMAP traceability warning surfaced during phase 42 close-out (noted but not detailed in transcript — should be investigated).

Phase 43 VERIFICATION.md status is gaps_found with verified gap closure — a re-verify after all gap plans were executed updated it, but the UAT items remain open for human sign-off before the phase can be truly closed.
